title: OrbitChain Event: asset_refund
description: Emitted once per asset when a donor's pro-rata refund is transferred for that asset. Multiple events may be emitted within a single claim_refund call. Topics: ["campaign", "asset_refund"]

asset_address.description: Contract address of the refunded asset (G...)

refund_amount.description: Amount refunded in the asset's base units, encoded as a decimal string
